en: A black-and-white image of a European city square in winter, with snow on the ground and several large, ornate 19th-century buildings visible. The architecture includes steeply pitched roofs and decorative spires. The view appears to be of a broad boulevard (esplanade) and a public square (torget), with people walking and a statue or fountain in the foreground. The text at the top is in Swedish.
